bio.text: Nick Hinrichsen is a Democrat who represents District 3 (Pueblo County) in the Colorado State Senate and serves as Majority Whip; Ballotpedia says he took office on February 28, 2022.
According to Ballotpedia, Hinrichsen earned a master's degree in public administration from Colorado University-Denver and served in the U.S. Army as a logistics officer.
As of March 2, 2022, Ballotpedia says, he was operations supervisor for Pueblo Transit.
